note: RFC changes that only surfaced while implementing (the line-by-line audit is in rfc_audit.json). en fields are paste-ready for the issue.

items.title_zh: O5 反向规则不是 CP 不变的
items.body_zh: 契约写的“dK/dV 按 query block 升序累加”在 CP 下做不到。已改为“整条序列 8 个规范 query 块、块间按 O3 树合并，每个 KV 头只在读它的 4 个 Q 头组之间合并”，单卡内核与 CP1/模拟 CP2/4/8/真实双卡 CP2 逐 bit 相同；代价是反向慢 5–14%。
items.title_en: The O5 backward accumulation rule is not CP-invariant
items.body_en: Replace "dK/dV accumulated over query blocks in ascending order" with: "dK/dV are accumulated per canonical query chunk (the full sequence split into 8 fixed chunks, independent of CP degree); the 8 chunk partials are combined in the O3 tree in fp32 and rounded once." The single-GPU kernel and every CP layout then produce identical bits; the old rule cannot be implemented when a rank only owns some query blocks.
items.evidence: rl_engine/models/muse_glimmer/runtime/REPORT_ws2_cp.md (CP1/2/4 equal; TP1 one-shot kernel rel 1.6e-5 apart)

items.title_zh: 注意力内核要接受头数参数
items.body_zh: 已实现：注意力内核接受 H_Q/H_KV，TP2/4/8 每个 rank 只算自己的 16/1、8/1、4/1 个头，前向反向都是 TP1 的逐 bit 切片；复制的 KV 头的 dK/dV 由各副本 fp32 部分和按规范树合并。vLLM 与 Megatron 都已改用这种调用，不再复制 KV 或 all-gather 头。
items.title_en: Attention rows must take head counts as parameters
items.body_en: State that the strict attention forward/backward take H_Q and H_KV (GQA group 16) and add a TP gate: for TP in {2,4,8} the per-rank call on its head shard (16/1, 8/1 with KV replication, 4/1) equals the matching slice of the full-geometry call bit for bit. Kernels that hard-code 32 Q / 2 KV heads force runtimes to replicate KV or all-gather heads.
items.evidence: rl_engine/models/muse_glimmer/runtime/REPORT_ws2_tp.md (open finding); vLLM and Megatron bindings worked around it

items.title_zh: Bridge 把 final norm 存成 w−1
items.body_zh: Megatron Bridge 把 model.language_model.norm.weight 存成 bf16 的 (w−1)，bf16(w_meg+1) 有 1120/6656 个元素和 HF 不同。weight_sync_identity 要写明：这个张量从 HF checkpoint 重载，预期 626/627 个张量逐字节相同。
items.title_en: Megatron Bridge stores the final norm as w-1
items.body_en: weight_sync_identity must allow one documented exception: Bridge keeps model.language_model.norm.weight as bf16(w - 1) (zero-centred gamma), and bf16(w_meg + 1) differs from the HF tensor at 1120/6656 elements. The strict path reloads that tensor from the HF checkpoint; expect 626/627 tensors byte-identical plus this one reloaded.

items.title_zh: Bridge 的 fused linear_qkv 布局
items.body_zh: 每个 KV 组 g（4352 行）= [q 头 16g..16g+15（2048）| gate 头（2048）| k 头 g（128）| v 头 g（128）]；linear_fc1 = [gate; up]。已在真权重上 torch.equal 验证。严格路径要按这个布局拆开成四个独立 GEMM。
items.title_en: Megatron Bridge fused linear_qkv layout
items.body_en: Document the Bridge layout the strict path un-fuses: per KV group g (4352 rows) = [q heads 16g..16g+15 (2048 rows) | output-gate rows for those heads (2048) | k head g (128) | v head g (128)]; linear_fc1 = [gate; up]. Verified with torch.equal against the HF tensors of the pinned checkpoint.

items.title_zh: 梯度容差要和尺度无关
items.body_zh: 反向的比较用归一化误差（相对于参考梯度的范数），固定 atol 在 30B 的梯度尺度上没有意义。
items.title_en: Gradient tolerances must be scale-free
items.body_en: Compare backward outputs with a normalised error (max |g - g_ref| / max |g_ref|, or a norm ratio); a fixed atol is meaningless across the gradient scales of a 30B model.

items.title_zh: O5 要写明 m = −inf 保护
items.body_zh: 整行都被 mask 掉时（局部窗口的边界、padding）：α = 1，p = 0，不产生 NaN。
items.title_en: O5 must state the m = -inf guard
items.body_en: When every key of a row is masked (window edges, padding) the running max stays -inf: define alpha = 1 and p = 0 so no NaN is produced, and make it part of the contract rather than an implementation detail.

items.title_zh: LoRA 不合并
items.body_zh: 两边都用 y = bf16(acc32(W·x) + Σ B·z)；把 LoRA 合并进 W 会改变 bit。
items.title_en: LoRA stays unmerged on both sides
items.body_en: Answer to open question 3: both runtimes compute y = bf16(acc32(W x) + sum_i B_i z_i) with z = A x; merging the adapter into W changes the bits and is not allowed in strict mode.

items.title_zh: 几行要改名或合并
items.body_zh: fused_add_rmsnorm → post_norm_residual_pre_norm（四范数夹心，(1+w) 增益，两个 eps 1e-5 / 1e-8）；注意力的 train / rollout 两行合成一行、两种执行模式；vocab_parallel_softcap_logp 并入 WS1 的 lm_head 行 + 一个传输行。
items.title_en: Rename / merge rows
items.body_en: fused_add_rmsnorm -> post_norm_residual_pre_norm (four-norm sandwich, (1+w) gain, eps 1e-5 and 1e-8); merge the attention train and rollout rows into one kernel row with two execution modes; fold vocab_parallel_softcap_logp into the WS1 lm_head row plus a transport row.

items.title_zh: 版本钉在 transformers 5.17.0
items.body_zh: vLLM 0.31 要 transformers<5.18，Megatron Bridge main 要 ≥5.15,<5.18：语义源从 5.19 改钉 5.17（commit 856157a2）。5.17 和 5.19 的区别：RoPE 表的构造（5.17 是受 TF32 影响的 matmul）。
items.title_en: Pin the semantics source to transformers 5.17.0
items.body_en: Only transformers 5.17.0 satisfies both vLLM 0.31 (<5.18) and Megatron Bridge main (>=5.15,<5.18). Pin the semantics source to 5.17.0 (856157a2f3e9594954310df18fdccc31ffddebe9) instead of 5.19.0; note that 5.17 builds the RoPE table with a TF32-sensitive matmul while 5.19 uses an fp32 elementwise product, so the strict RoPE table is built by our own fixed fp32 function on both runtimes.

items.title_zh: 不要假设 Hopper
items.body_zh: 仓库现有的严格内核（FA4 CuTe、SM90 线性 logp）在 A100 上不可用，原有 Triton 确定性 GEMM 只有 5 TFLOP/s。RFC 应把“一个与架构无关的 Triton 参考实现”列为基础行，Hopper 专用内核作为优化行。
items.title_en: Do not assume Hopper
items.body_en: The repo's strict FA4/CuTe attention and SM90 linear-logp kernels do not run on A100, and the existing Triton deterministic GEMM reaches about 5 TFLOP/s. Make an architecture-neutral Triton implementation of every row the foundation (this POC reaches 105-135 TFLOP/s with an 8-leaf K tree on A100) and treat Hopper-specific kernels as optimisation rows.

items.title_zh: 两个运行时不能在一个进程里
items.body_zh: vLLM 0.31（torch cu130）和 Megatron Bridge + TransformerEngine（torch cu129）装不进同一个环境；E2E 用跨进程 trainer 桥，只传 token id、fp32 的 dL/dlogp（代理 loss Σ lp·g 的梯度恰好是 g）和带哈希的 LoRA。Megatron 训练侧现已支持 TP4（TP8 未测，默认关闭）。
items.title_en: The two runtimes cannot share a process
items.body_en: vLLM 0.31 (torch cu130) and Megatron Bridge + TransformerEngine (torch cu129) cannot share one environment, so the E2E row needs a cross-process trainer bridge that moves only token ids, fp32 dL/dlogprob (applied through the surrogate loss sum(lp*g), whose gradient is exactly g) and hash-verified LoRA tensors. Training-side TP4 now works and equals TP1 bit for bit; TP8 is untested and gated.

items.title_zh: 两遍 tile 内核必须禁止 FP 融合
items.body_zh: 第二遍重算 zhat 时编译器把 softcap·tanh − m 融成一个 FMA，最大值的 exp 不再恰好是 1，near-certain token 的 logp 比 0 大 1–2 ulp（30B 上 48/1024 个生成 token）。契约要写明：重算同一个量的两遍必须产生同样的舍入（编译时关闭 FP contraction）。
items.title_en: Two-pass tile kernels must not contract FP operations
items.body_en: Pass 2 of the O7 tile statistics recomputes zhat; with FP contraction softcap*tanh(..) - m becomes one FMA, the tile maximum's exp(zhat - m) is no longer exactly 1 and near-certain tokens get logp 1-2 ulp above zero (48/1024 generated tokens on the 30B). State that any quantity recomputed in a later pass must be rounded identically (compile those kernels without FP contraction).

items.title_zh: 编译器可能把声明的树折掉
items.body_zh: K 很小时每个 K 块只迭代一次，Triton 把 8 叶树的加法折进 MMA 累加链（7 个加法剩 3 个），K=256/512 的输出约一半偏离契约。“BLOCK_K 不改变 bit”的说法不成立。契约要求每块至少两次迭代，并检查编译后的 IR。
items.title_en: The compiler can erase the declared reduction tree
items.body_en: With one K iteration per chunk, Triton folded the 8-leaf tree adds into the MMA accumulation chain (3 of 7 adds left) and about half of the K=256/512 outputs deviated from the contract. Require >= 2 iterations per chunk (static_assert) and a check of the compiled IR in the qualification row; drop the claim that BLOCK_K never changes bits.

items.title_zh: 列并行 GEMM 的 dA 必须在舍入前合并
items.body_zh: 每个 rank 先把 dA 舍入到 bf16 再相加，TP2/4/8 时 37–41% 的元素和 TP1 不同。正确做法：每个 rank 输出 fp32 部分和，用规范树合并后只舍入一次。
items.title_en: Column-parallel dA must be combined before rounding
items.body_en: Rounding each rank's dA to bf16 before the all-reduce makes 37-41 % of the elements differ from TP1 at TP2/4/8. Each rank must emit its fp32 sub-tree partial; the partials are combined in the canonical tree and rounded once.
items.evidence: kernels_gemm.json det_gemm_2_tp_probe; megatron_runtime.json (TP1 == TP2 == TP4 grads)

items.title_zh: RoPE 表必须在 CUDA 上用同一个函数构造
items.body_zh: 同一公式在 CPU 和 GPU 上构造，cos/sin 约 20% 的表项 bit 不同；HF 在 CPU 上算 inv_freq，GPU 上算 64 个里有 4 个不同，会让 924/933 个 token 变 bit。契约 O4 已要求“一次构造、缓存同一个对象”，还应要求运行时记录表的哈希并在两边比较。
items.title_en: Build the RoPE table once, on CUDA, with one function
items.body_en: The same formula built on CPU and on CUDA differs in about 20 % of the cos/sin entries; HF's CPU-built inv_freq differs from a GPU build in 4 of 64 entries, which changes 924/933 token logprobs. Keep O4's 'built once, cached, same object' and add: record the table's SHA-256 in both runtimes' provenance and fail the run if they differ.

items.title_zh: LoRA 梯度要与 micro-batch 打包无关
items.body_zh: 原实现的梯度依赖 micro-batch 怎么打包（14,860/20,480 个元素随打包变化）。现在 token 维的权重梯度逐序列计算、按样本顺序左折叠，512/4096/8192 三种打包结果一致。契约要写明这个规则。
items.title_en: LoRA gradients must not depend on micro-batch packing
items.body_en: The first binding's LoRA gradients changed with the micro-batch packing (14,860 of 20,480 elements). The POC now computes the token-axis weight gradient per sequence with det_gemm's 256-token rule and folds sequences left to right in sample order; 512/4096/8192-token packings give identical gradients at TP1/2/4. Declare this rule in the contract.

items.title_zh: 严格模式必须“失败即关闭”，包括运行时选择
items.body_zh: Megatron 绑定曾在严格内核缺失时静默回退；vLLM 在退回 V1 model runner 时严格路径被绕过。RFC 应列出严格模式下禁止的功能（V1 runner、prefix caching、KV offload、投机解码等）和必须报错的情形。
items.title_en: Strict mode must fail closed, including runtime selection
items.body_en: The Megatron binding once fell back to torch/cuBLAS when a strict kernel was missing, and vLLM's V1 model runner bypasses the strict sampler path. List the features that strict mode forbids (V1 runner, prefix caching, KV offload/transfer, speculative decoding, ...) and require a hard error instead of a fallback.
items.evidence: review_wave_a2.json megatron_runtime:R1; wave B vLLM verify NEW-1

items.title_zh: 哈希要在每个 worker 上对实际加载的张量重算
items.body_zh: rollout 侧原来只回显编排器声明的哈希。现在每个 TP worker 对自己加载的 LoRA 重算 muse_glimmer_lora_sha256_v1，全部一致才算同步成功；torchrun 下的 trainer 每个 rank 也要比对。
items.title_en: Weight-sync hashes must be recomputed by every worker
items.body_en: The rollout first echoed the hash the orchestrator declared. Each TP worker must recompute muse_glimmer_lora_sha256_v1 on the tensors it actually loaded and the sync passes only if all agree; under torchrun every trainer rank's hash is compared too.

items.title_zh: 漂移指标要能区分大小，argmax 翻转要考虑并列
items.body_zh: “bit 不同的 token 数”在原生栈上几乎总是 98–99%，要同时报告 |Δlogp|、全词表 KL 和按概率分桶；bf16 softcap logits 有精确并列，45 次 argmax 翻转里 39 次发生在并列处。
items.title_en: Drift metrics need magnitudes and tie-aware argmax
items.body_en: 'Tokens with different bits' saturates near 100 % on native stacks; also report |dlogp|, full-vocabulary KL and a breakdown by gold-token probability. bf16 soft-capped logits have exact top-1 ties (16 of 933 positions) and 39 of 45 raw argmax flips fall on a tie, so count ties separately or compare fp32 argmax.

items.title_zh: 采样用的 logits 来源要写清楚
items.body_zh: 严格 vLLM 记录的 logprob 来自严格路径，但选 token 时仍用原生 bf16 logits（已声明的偏差）。RFC 要说明严格模式下 token 选择是否也必须来自严格 logits。
items.title_en: Say where the sampled token comes from
items.body_en: The strict vLLM binding reports strict logprobs but still selects tokens from the native bf16 logits (a declared deviation). State whether strict mode must also sample from the strict logits; logprobs are identical either way, token choices across TP were identical in every strict run.
